title: Chapter 486 - 486 Slap Yourself; Greetings, Mr. Lin!
content:
Chapter 486 - 486 Slap Yourself; Greetings, Mr. Lin!

Chapter 486 - 486 Slap Yourself; Greetings, Mr. Lin!

486 Slap Yourself; Greetings, Mr. Lin!

The red-haired man beside him muttered, “A MJ yacht? This seems to be William’s family’s ship, right?”

The man with an ear stud, the man in sunglasses, and the others all looked at Huo Qilong in confusion when they saw his surprise.

“Why, do you know him?”

“Who is it? Why are you so surprised?”

Huo Qilong raised his finger and said, “The one in the white dress is the beauty I was talking about.”

“Oh?”

When everyone heard this, they could not help but cast curious gazes in the direction Huo Qilong was pointing.

Huo Qilong had praised her too much just now.

Soon, the eyes of the man with an ear stud, the man in sunglasses, the man with light red hair, and the others lit up.

Snow-white skin, a voluptuous figure, an exquisite face…

Under the illumination of the sun, her body seemed to be shining with silver light.

Beautiful!

She was so beautiful!

The man with an ear stud shouted excitedly, “Beauty, come over and have a drink!”

As he spoke, he deliberately waved the Lafite in his hand.

The man wearing the sunglasses raised his watch and waved at Chu Yunyue. “Beauty, let’s be friends.”

The man with light red hair shouted, “Beauty, do you like yachts too? Our yacht, Hero, is bigger, more luxurious, and more comfortable. Do you want to come up and play?”

While the three of them were shouting greetings, they also casually showed off their wine, watch, and yacht.

“How is it? Pretty, isn’t it?”

The man in sunglasses, the man with an ear stud, the man with light red hair, and the others nodded.

When Lin Fan heard the voices, he turned around.

When he saw that it was Huo Qilong and the others, he raised his eyebrows slightly.

The first time that Huo Qilong had taken the initiative to strike up a conversation with Chu Yunyue, Lin Fan ignored him.

The second time, Lin Fan ignored him as well.

This was the third time.

Moreover, from what he said, it seemed like he was showing off Chu Yunyue like an object.

Huo Qilong and his friends kept teasing Chu Yunyue in front of him.

This made Lin Fan furious.

It seemed that sometimes… one could not be too kind.

Lin Fan said coldly, “All of you kneel down and slap yourself ten times. Do that and I can consider not taking your words to heart.”

The man with an ear stud, the man in sunglasses, the man with light red hair, and Huo Qilong were stunned.

Then, as if they had heard the funniest joke in the world, they all burst into laughter.

“Hahaha! What did I hear?”

“You want us to kneel down and slap ourselves ten times? And then you’ll consider not making a fuss about what we just said?”

…

One had to know…

Which of their families did not have a huge amount of wealth and power?

Ever since they were young, they were the only ones who threatened and bullied others.

They had never been bullied or threatened before.

It was no wonder that they would laugh so loudly.

What if Lin Fan had shown off his power the moment he appeared?

Perhaps, the man with the ear stud and the others would not be so unscrupulous.

However, Lin Fan was only on a medium-sized MJ yacht.

The medium-sized MJ yacht, which cost more than 100 million yuan, was considered acceptable.

However, in their eyes, it was not enough.

Furthermore, the red-haired man had just pointed out that this MJ yacht belonged to the William family.

William’s family was in the yacht and car rental business.

This meant… the other party did not even have a yacht worth more than 100 million yuan.

With such little strength, he still dared to threaten them?

What a joke!

After a while, the men stopped laughing and shouted, “Kid, I’ll return the words you just said! Now, kneel down and slap yourself ten times! I can consider ignoring what you said just now!”

“That’s right!” the man in sunglasses shouted.

“Ten slaps?” the man with light red hair asked. “No! 100 slaps!”

“Kneel down and slap yourself a hundred times!”

Everyone kept shouting.

…

At this moment.

Not far away on the sea, on a large yacht.

Several middle-aged men in suits and leather shoes were sipping champagne and chatting softly. They looked very relaxed.

A man wearing silver-rimmed glasses said, “When it comes to educating children, sometimes you can’t force them too hard.

“My son used to like to play games. Later, he borrowed 500 million yuan from me and started a gaming team.

“I thought that all this money was going down the drain. In the end, his gaming team won the championship last year, which directly increased the value of the team by several times.”

The man with the buzz cut nodded and said, “I agree. My son likes to watch live broadcasts and tips those internet celebrities tens of millions every day.

“I thought that I had given birth to a prodigal son.

“In the end, this kid actually used the money from the tips to establish a good relationship with the internet celebrities. Later on, he opened his own live-streaming platform and is now preparing to go public.”

The man with a cigar in his mouth touched his chin and said, “Perhaps it’s not a bad thing that my son likes to pick up girls?”

“Yeah, maybe one day he’ll set up a modeling company or a film company!” the man with a buzz cut said.

“Hahaha! In that case, I can look forward to it a little.” The man with the crew cut laughed.

Everyone was discussing their sons, and the atmosphere was very relaxed.

At this moment, the man with a buzz cut looked at the man wearing gold-rimmed glasses beside him and said in a fawning tone, “Mr. He, I heard that you went to Hua Nation with the chairman of Jiawen Group, Mr. Herrs, the chairman of Datong Group, Mr. Li Jiawei, and the chairmen of many other giant companies?”

As soon as he said that, the man with the crew cut, the man with the silver-rimmed glasses, and everyone else looked at him curiously.

Obviously, they were very curious.

The image of a young man gradually appeared in Mr. He’s mind.

It was Lin Fan!

Thinking of Lin Fan, a hint of respect appeared on Mr. He’s face.

He slowly raised his head and was about to say something.

The next moment, Mr. He’s pupils constricted slightly as he stood up abruptly.

That was because he saw two yachts not far away.

Lin Fan was standing on one of the yachts!

He was the current sect master of the Qing Hong Sect!

Mr. He bowed and called out in a very respectful tone, “Greetings, Mr. Lin.”

When the man with a crew cut, the man in silver-framed glasses, the man with a buzz cut, the man smoking a cigar, and the others heard this, their hearts skipped a beat.

They could not help but look in the direction of Mr. He’s shout. They saw a young man in his 20s, and their hearts skipped a beat.

One had to know…

Mr. He was the chairman of Rising Sun Group.

He was an existence that they would try their best to please!

Rising Sun Group was one of the top 500 companies in the world!

However, Mr. He actually bowed to a young man and greeted him in such a respectful tone?

Who was this young man?!
